lines.en: I swim through the shallows with quick tail beats.
One tail beat turns me.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸游，找小东西。
lines.en: I swim along the bank looking for small things.
I pass between the reed roots.
I turn among the water weeds.
I swim fast; I am very light.

lines.zh: 我摆尾时水面有一圈纹。
lines.en: My tail leaves a ring on the surface.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，又浮上来一点。
lines.en: I sink, then rise a little.
I swim along the swamp's edge.

lines.zh: 我绕着露出水面的石头转。
lines.en: I loop around a stone above water.
I head up toward the surface.
I pass under a floating leaf.
I stop in a shallow dip and beat my tail.
I swim from the bend to the shallows.
I hover, gills working.
I tilt my body to one side.

lines.zh: 我在等水面掉下什么东西。
lines.en: I wait for something to fall on the surface.
My back is dark.
The water is murky, but I can see.
One tail beat holds me still.
There are no big fish here.
I keep against the bottom stones.
My eye turns slowly.
I do not need to come to the surface.

lines.zh: 水草边上有个洞，我进去过。
lines.en: There is a hollow by the weeds; I have been in it.
I sank another inch deeper.
The sand here is fine.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，几乎看不见。
lines.en: I am so still I am almost invisible.
I tilt up at you from the water.
Your hand is in the water.
You are larger than anything in this water.
I hid on the far side of the stone.
The surface bends my shape.

lines.zh: 我从水下打量了你一阵。
lines.en: I studied you from under the water.
I back away slowly.
When you move, the water sounds.

lines.zh: 我抓不住的东西，我不碰。
lines.en: What I cannot hold, I leave alone.
One dart and I am clear.
I spun once on the sand.
One beat of my tail took me off.
I hide in a crevice.
Tilted sideways, I swim down.
I sink back to the sand.
That one bit deep.
The water is too churned; I cannot see.
I beat my tail and recovered.
Is that a small grub?
I rise toward it.
I opened my mouth and shut it.
I cannot bite through it.
I circle it once.
It sank all the way down.
I chase it along the surface.
That tasted good.
Do you have any more?
You touch me and I dart away.
A bump in water is light.
I come back around the other side.
That muddied the water.
I am too slippery to hold.
The shove rolls me.
One tail flick and I sink deeper.
One of my fins is crooked.
One tail beat steadied me.
Do not put your hand in the shallows.
The water warms, and so this comes.

lines.zh: 我们说不上话，只有水声。
lines.en: We have no words, only water.
We lift a layer off the sand.
Its tail brushed mine.
Nothing is clear in the water.
This stretch is very brief.

lines.zh: 我又游回深一点的地方。
lines.en: I swim back to deeper water.

lines.zh: 水草后面，有条安静的水道。
lines.en: Behind the weeds there's a quiet channel.
One gulp and it was gone.
This does not look edible.
I spat it out again.
It is bigger than my mouth.
I nudge it and it drifts off.
I bit down and will not open again.
I push it into a crevice.
I will not touch this.
It settled on the sand.
I froze in the water.
Something stirs; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 三叠纪的小鱼，转头就跑。
lines.en: A small Triassic fish turns and flees.
I crept in by degrees.
This is much smaller than me.
I opened my mouth wide.
I have judged this distance right.
A ring spreads on the surface.
I go in from below.
This bite must be quick.
It has not seen me under the water.
I beat my tail once.
I follow it with my tail working.
My upper jaw has stayed open.

lines.zh: 水草挡了一下，我穿过去。
lines.en: The weeds catch me; I pass through.
I need not be fast; I only need follow.
It has come to the surface.
My shadow falls on the sand.
Only the last little bit.
It has suddenly started to move.
I beat my tail and follow.

lines.zh: 我又绕了一圈，从上面来。
lines.en: I circle again and come from above.
That bite closed on empty water.
I bite off a scale.
I drag it onto the sand.
My teeth are very fine.
One twist and it pulled free.
I beat my tail and chased again.
One tail beat took me off to the side.
There is a taste in my mouth.
A thin shadow appears on the bottom.
I slide out of the reeds.
Small rings cross the surface.
I hold in the shallows.
The sand is soft here.
I drift in with the weeds.
I do not know this stretch of bank.
The water is just cool enough.
I sink to the bottom to look first.
I come in skimming the surface.
I hide under a clump of weeds.
I land on mud, tail flapping.

lines.zh: 水太多也会呛，我张着嘴。
lines.en: Too much water can drown you; my mouth gapes.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进我肋下的软处。
lines.en: Something lodged in the soft place under my ribs.

lines.zh: 一股力顺着水过来，我僵了。
lines.en: Some force comes through the water and I stiffen.
Hunger leaves me unable to swim.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整条都木了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and I go numb.
